body:
by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · exact ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr
  case choice p q r hbisim =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' htr
      cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', hbisim'⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst htr
        exists q'
        constructor
        · exact Tr.choiceL htr'
        · exact ChoiceBisim.bisim hbisim'
      case choiceR htr =>
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · exact Tr.choiceR htr
        · exact ChoiceBisim.bisim (by grind [HomBisimilarity.refl])
    · intro s2' htr
      cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', hbisim'⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd htr
        exists p'
        constructor
        · exact Tr.choiceL htr'
        · exact ChoiceBisim.bisim hbisim'
      case choiceR htr =>
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · exact Tr.choiceR htr
        · exact ChoiceBisim.bisim (by grind [HomBisimilarity.refl])
  case bisim h =>
    grind [IsBisimulation, ChoiceBisim]
